articles.author: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd.
articles.headline: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Reports Positive Interim Data from Ongoing Phase 2/3 Study of QRX003 in Netherton Syndrome
articles.summary: Quoin reported interim results from the first six participants completing 12 weeks in its ongoing QRX003 Netherton study, with four meeting the stated improvement threshold. These are company-reported interim data, not regulatory approval.

articles.author: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd.
articles.headline: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Announces Private Placement Financing of Up to $50.0 Million
articles.summary: Quoin announced approximately $30.8 million upfront private placement funding, with up to$19.2 million additional proceeds dependent on cash warrant exercise. The headline maximum was not fully received at announcement.
